title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or civil draftsperson (Busselton or Perth)
content_text:
JDSi Consulting Engineers careers page (checked 14 Oct 2026).

We are currently recruiting for the following roles:
- Civil Designer (Busselton)
- Civil Designer (Perth)

We are a friendly, personable team that genuinely enjoys working together. We have a social club, Friday drinks and provide fresh fruit and great coffee! We also back your wellbeing with a wellness allowance you can use for gym or other health-related expenses. We value different perspectives and career stages, and provide the tools, processes and leadership you need to do your best work.

If you would like to have a conversation with JDSi regarding your next career move, please forward your CV and cover letter to recruitment@jdsi.com.au. All applications are confidential.

Please be advised that we are not engaging the services of Recruitment Agents. We will accept direct applications only.

Company work (from jdsi.com.au services): civil engineering for master planned developments, subdivisions, brownfield and industrial developments; roads; earthworks; stormwater drainage; water and wastewater; power and communications. WA Water Corporation prequalified consultant. Offices include Perth and Busselton (South West).

NOTE FOR SCREENING: LinkedIn hiring posts for the Busselton Civil Designer role describe about four years drafting/design experience plus intermediate to advanced AutoCAD and 12D. This speculative enquiry is NOT an application for those experienced Civil Designer vacancies. It uses the careers page invitation to email a CV for an early career or graduate civil design / drafting conversation.
